limitations: Coverage is limited to these four assigned exact matrix pairs. No full-round acceptance or record-review action was performed.

The four saved case records repeat the assigned run/source/binary/reference identities and evidence declarations. Current production files, historical candidate images, historical verdicts and mechanical PASS fields were not used as visual evidence.

Candidates were opened from their assigned original 930x1240 PNG paths. Original references are 1860x2480 at physical scale two; view_image displayed them at 1368x1824. No images were copied, cropped, processed or opened beyond the eight-image budget.
Only existing case/state/action/metadata/log and assigned provider text were read. No application, test, build, probe, validator, SQL query, hash command, SSH session or skill search program was run.

Static screenshots and saved actions do not qualify hidden hit regions, physical input, hardware rotation, physical sleep/wake, e-ink behavior, performance or a live-reader lease. Pause, resume, cancellation, menu-choice execution and page selection were not newly exercised.
Default, jump-pages and more are saved demo snapshots; the download queue is the saved actual loopback-provider capture. Dataset content differences do not waive geometry or truthful feedback.
No historical disposition was imported as a current suggestion or closure. The owner declares the full manifest pending; final full-run reconciliation remains outside this batch.
